function.name: render_c4_workspace
function.description: Validate a Structurizr DSL workspace inside the containerized Playwright runtime, batch-export all C4 views to normalized 1080p-ready SVGs with Mode A progressive .steps.json sidecars, and run the DESIGN-TOKENS.md font and legibility gates.

dsl.description: Path to the Structurizr workspace.dsl file.

out.description: Output directory for normalized .svg, .steps.json, .meta.json, and optional .png files.

spec.description: Optional path to views.json specifying per-view slot (full|composite|split) and ordered progressive reveal steps.

png.description: Also render @2x PNG previews via Playwright Chromium.

function.name: render_c4_video
function.description: Render a 1920x1080@30fps progressive C4 video clip using Mode A (Master SVG + 0.35s cross-dissolve) from a normalized .svg and its sibling .steps.json.

svg.description: Path to the normalized master .svg file.

title.description: Slide title displayed above the diagram.

duration.description: Target total video duration in seconds.

ghost.description: Optional opacity for unrevealed elements (default 0.0 = visibility: hidden; e.g. 0.10 for faint silhouettes).
